title: Bern-Barcelona EEG database: focal and nonfocal intracranial EEG signal pairs (Andrzejak, Schindler & Rummel 2012)
description: The Bern-Barcelona EEG database contains 7500 pairs of intracranial EEG signals (3750 focal and 3750 non-focal) from five patients with pharmacoresistant temporal lobe epilepsy. Each 20-second, 512 Hz, two-channel segment was drawn from seizure-free long-term recordings to support nonlinear time series analysis of focal versus non-focal activity. This BIDS release is a lossless repackaging of the original published text files, with all runs pooled under a single pseudo-subject.
methods_description: Patients underwent long-term intracranial EEG recording with AD-TECH strip and depth electrodes. The source data were band-pass filtered at 0.5-150 Hz (zero-phase Butterworth), down-sampled to 512 Hz where needed, and re-referenced to the median of artifact-free channels. Focal channels were identified by visual inspection of the first ictal changes. Neighbouring-channel pairs were randomly drawn from 20-s windows, excluding seizures and the three hours after the last seizure. Values were converted from text to BrainVision float32 without modification.
